# Introduction


# Data Source


# Load packages and import data


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
url<-"C:/Users/tenlh/Downloads/MTA_Subway_Hourly_Ridership__2020-2024_20261112 (1).csv"
mta_raw<-read_csv(url)

```

```{r}
# Data Cleaning
mta_clean<-mta_raw%>%
  # remove "OMNY - " from fare_class_category 
  mutate(fare_class_category=str_remove(fare_class_category,
                                        "OMNY - "))%>%
  # split transit timestap
  mutate(datetime_obj = mdy_hms(transit_timestamp),
         transit_date=as.Date(datetime_obj),
    transit_time = format(datetime_obj, "%I:%M:%S %p")
          )

  mta_selected<-mta_clean%>%select(transit_date,transit_time,transit_mode,borough,payment_method,fare_class_category,ridership)




```

```{r}

glimpse(mta_selected)

```
# which borough have the highest ridership?

```{r}
riderShip_count_borough<-mta_selected%>%
  group_by(borough)%>%
  summarize(total_ridership=sum(ridership,na.rm = TRUE))

```

```{r}
ggplot(riderShip_count_borough,
       aes(x = borough, y = total_ridership, fill=borough)) +
  geom_col() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +

  labs(
    title = "Total Subway Ridership by Borough",
    x = "Borough",
    y = "Total Ridership",
    fill = "Borough"

  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

Which fare categories are most commonly used?

```{r}
mta_selected %>%
  group_by(fare_class_category) %>%
  summarize(total_ridership = sum(ridership, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(fare_class_category =
           fct_reorder(fare_class_category, total_ridership, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fare_class_category, y = total_ridership)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(total_ridership)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Ridership by Fare Category",
    x = "Fare Category",
    y = "Total Ridership"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
